result: Current Xenoverse 2 evidence confirms a 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate obtained from PQ154. The user fires a ring-shaped projectile that captures the opponent in a cutscene; the ring then explodes for documented damage. The maintained repository retains the 40% Ultimate-Finish bonus-slot interpretation despite an independent PQ listing placing the skill in Basic Rewards; this conflict is not collapsed.
evidence_boundary: No narrower CaC race/gender/form restriction is inferred from current evidence.
